title: Monsters at the walls
Long nights in {settlement}
summary: Monsters prowl round {settlement} every night. Kill {count} of them near the town after dark.
The folk of {settlement} bar their doors at dusk. Thin out the monsters: kill {count} near town at night.
offer: They come every night now, scratching at the shutters. Kill {count} of them near the town after dark and I'll see you paid.
We've lost two sheep and nearly lost a child. Clear the monsters from round {settlement} at night: {count} of them.
progress: Keep at it. The town's sleeping better already.
complete: Quiet nights at last. Thank you.
The children played outside after dark yesterday. That's your doing.
